title: The summary strip shows seven figures in a fixed order, each as US-dollar currency
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Work In Progress report is open with rows loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Read the summary strip across the top of the report, left to right.
2. Read each figure's number format.
custom_expected:
1. The strip shows seven figures, in this order: Total Earned, Total Remaining, Not Started, Started — Earned, Started — Remaining, Ready to Invoice, and Estimates.
2. Every figure shows US-dollar currency with a leading "$", two decimals, and thousands separators.
